title: setup in a worktree rewrites main checkout rules
what: relay setup run in a linked worktree writes nothing outside that worktree: the rules sync it runs at the end does not rewrite the main checkout's CLAUDE.local.md (or it is skipped with one line saying so), and a sync held by a waiting paid run is not reported as a failed setup (exit 1).
why: Found 26 Oct as F7 of the design review of setup-turns-off-for-a-project-the-plugins-it-doe (traced by reading, not run, since it would touch live files): after setup() writes settings.json, cmd_setup calls relay_rules.sync(only={"relay"}) with ROOT = the worktree, which renders /Users/amidman/relay/CLAUDE.local.md (projects.toml [relay] file) from the worktree's rules, or prints "Not synced" and exits 1 while merges wait for a paid run. Blocks relay-s-repo-records-the-plugins-relay-developme (it runs setup in a worktree). The portable design plans that relay writes no CLAUDE.local.md at all (owner, 26 Oct); this fix may fold into that. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: A reproduction in a temporary relay copy with a linked worktree and a temporary projects.toml: `relay setup <worktree> --off x` rewrites the main checkout's CLAUDE.local.md.
pass_cases: The same run leaves the main checkout's files byte-identical; a held sync prints one line and setup exits 0.
where: bin/relay cmd_setup (lines 421-425): the relay_rules.sync call after setup
lib/relay_rules.py the project target from projects.toml
